rejectedVariant.reason: Rejected after external audit: vanilla Trouble in the Big City already combines Streets-bound PMC elimination with survive/extract semantics. Lowering the PMC count does not create enough gameplay differentiation.

replacementVariant.intent: Intercept a small contractor element crossing the military reserve and extract after the contact. Reserve removes the proven Streets semantic collision while preserving a bounded military-interdiction identity.

conditionAuthority.boundary: AnyPmc, RezervBase and Survived extraction are individually proven shapes. The prior TarkovStreets variant remains rejected for strong vanilla semantic overlap. Frozen campaign overlap for the Reserve replacement is resolved; external vanilla/Scorpion/Artem uniqueness and same-raid temporal coupling remain fail-closed.

economyReview.review: The numeric envelope remains conservative. XP and RUB stay below the pinned vanilla Elimination medians, standing remains below the overall vanilla median, and there is no item reward, PMC gear faucet, dogtag conveyor or capability unlock. Re-run only if the objective becomes materially harder than the current four-PMC/one-extraction bound.
